global.title: Roundtables: A Conversation With the Creator of AI-Designed Viruses
global.summary: Friday, October 16, 2026 Can AI design new life forms? In 2025, Stanford University PhD student Samuel King came up with a preliminary answer when he used a generative AI
global.summaryKo: 2025년 스탠퍼드 박사과정생 새뮤얼 킹이 생성형 AI로 미세 바이러스의 유전 설계도를 제안했다. MIT 테크놀로지 리뷰가 AI가 생명체를 설계할 수 있는지 그와 이야기한다.
global.summaryEn: In 2025, Stanford PhD student Samuel King used a generative AI model to propose genetic blueprints for microscopic viruses. MIT Technology Review talks with him about whether AI can design life.
